parole.testo: From French foire, 1930s, from Old French foire from a Vulgar Latin *fēria, from the classical Latin fēriae, from Proto-Italic *fēziās, from Proto-Indo-European.
Inherited from Ottoman Turkish ژون (jön), from French jeune, from Middle French jeune, from Old French juene, from Vulgar Latin *iŏvenem, from Latin iuvenem. Doublet of civan.
